subject: Who called the Bharat bandh
alt: Cartoon, in two parts: under a picture of the Prime Minister on the wall stands a leader in a saffron gamchha, facing a man in a white kurta. In the first part the man says: in view of your grand Bharat bandh against the opposition, the opposition should immediately... The leader smiles. In the second part he completes the sentence: ...resign, and you should take its place. The leader's eyes go wide.
chutki: The Bharat bandh was so far the opposition's weapon. This time the city government shut things down: metro shut, rail shut, internet shut, so the opposition could not come onto the street. Dhodapkar's man takes this reversal to its final conclusion: if you are doing what the opposition used to do, then change chairs too.

In the first part the leader's smile shows he is expecting praise for himself and the opposition's resignation. The moment the sentence is complete, the same face is stunned. The picture hanging on the wall above keeps smiling the same way both times, as if the completion of a sentence made no difference to it.
